text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mechanism check, post hoc: 1115 injected level shifts of depth at least 3% of capacity (bank events), each with the mirrored step put on the real-graph neighbours only. Bar: share of the shift that the forecast copies when it should not. Colour: the family of the forecast (stored forecast, rule, flag, or gate). N-gate with zero neighbours gets no neighbour information.'
